_comment: Hand-maintained: everything the APK contains that does not come through Gradle, plus the projects Shiny's own GPL code derives from. Each fact was checked against the cited source on 2026-10-01; see LICENSE_COMPLIANCE.md. Paths in noticeFiles are relative to the repository root.

components.name: Shiny
copyright: Portions copyright their respective authors (see NOTICE)
components.description: This app. Its NOTICE, below, records the copyright and the open-source work Shiny builds upon.

groups.title: Upstream projects
groups.footer: Shiny's source code incorporates code from these GPL-3.0 projects, which stays under their licence.

components.name: InnerTune
copyright: InnerTune contributors, created by Zion Huang (see the project's git history)
components.description: The original project Metrolist was forked from (2024): database, InnerTube client, menus and much of the player.

components.name: Metrolist
components.description: Major upstream code and components: player, widgets, recognition, lyrics providers, stream resolution. Fix403.kt and most of YTPlayerUtils.kt are a Metrolist-based patch by Francesco Grazioso (August 2026).

components.name: vivi-music
components.description: Upstream modifications and components: the canvas and artist-video modules, YouLyPlus lyrics and the audio-device sheet.

components.name: ArchiveTune
components.description: Spotify client and Spotify import code (app/…/spotify and app/…/spotifyimport, 18 files), which carry ArchiveTune's notice. Also code in the Discord presence and sign-in, the local-file scanner, the ListenBrainz client and the Unison lyrics module.

components.name: Convx
copyright: Convx contributors (see the project's git history)
components.description: A vivi-music fork. ui/component/GlassEffect.kt and the liquid-glass settings come from Convx commit 1cecfbb (July 2026), which also vendored Kyant0/backdrop and compose-floating-tab-bar. GlassEffect.kt keeps the vivimusic notice Convx's files carried.

components.name: MusicRecognizer
components.description: Metrolist's music recognition (the shazamkit module and the recognition code Shiny inherits) is credited by Metrolist as based on MusicRecognizer (Metrolist commit 80a019e1, February 2026, and its README).

components.name: vibra
components.description: recognition/ShazamSignatureGenerator.kt is Metrolist's Kotlin port of vibra's audio fingerprinting algorithm (Metrolist commit ac8b2b53, February 2026).

components.name: Backdrop (Kyant0/AndroidLiquidGlass)
components.description: 30 source files in ui/component/backdrop, vendored from io.github.kyant0:backdrop 2.0.0. Modified by Convx (package rename, single source set, backdrop resolution scale) and by the Shiny Project (four files, each marked).

components.name: compose-floating-tab-bar
copyright: FloatingTabBar v1.0.1 by Elyes Mansour (the upstream LICENSE leaves its copyright line unfilled)
components.description: ui/component/floatingtabbar/FloatingTabBar.kt, vendored from the v1.0.1 tag with the local modifications listed in its header.

components.name: meriyah
copyright: Copyright (c) 2019 and later, KFlash and others.
components.description: assets/solver/meriyah.js: the unmodified dist/meriyah.umd.js of meriyah 6.1.4.

components.name: astring
components.description: assets/solver/astring.js: the unmodified dist/astring.min.js of astring 1.9.0.

components.name: yt-dlp/ejs
components.description: assets/solver/yt.solver.core.js: the unmodified yt.solver.core.js release asset of ejs 0.4.0.

components.name: Inter
components.description: res/font/inter_variable.ttf: the unmodified InterVariable.ttf of the Inter 4.1 release. No Reserved Font Name.

components.name: LLVM libc++ (libc++_shared.so)
components.description: The C++ runtime packaged inside ffmpeg-kit-audio. The licence text shown is the LLVM section of the Android NDK 27 toolchain NOTICE.
